stories.title: Recreation funding, ice rental fee increases criticized in Calgary’s proposed budget
stories.summary: The City of Calgary's upcoming four-year budget proposal includes potential increases to ice time fees for youth sports like hockey, figure skating and ringette.

stories.title: Edmonton Elks want ‘City of Champions’ signs to return
stories.summary: The Edmonton Elks are champions again, and they want their city to show it.

stories.title: AGLC given permission to look at selling Play Alberta to new operator
stories.summary: The AGLC is considering selling Play Alberta, a government-owned gambling website launched in 2020, as it weighs its future role in the province’s newly launched iGaming market.

stories.title: Alberta government tables bill to adopt redrawn electoral ridings
stories.summary: The NDP says the changes are an attempt to rig the 2027 election, while the UCP says it's about boosting effective representation and that hybrid ridings already exist in Alberta.

stories.title: TC Energy plans to grow Alberta pipeline network to serve oilsands, power plants
stories.summary: The line would be part of a broader plan to grow the NGTL, which has been in operation for almost 70 years and forms a vast web stretching throughout Alberta and into northern B.C.

stories.title: CNRL buying Advantage Energy in deal valued at $2.53B, including debt
stories.summary: Calgary-based Canadian Natural Resources is adding to its footprint in northwestern Alberta with a deal to buy Advantage Energy Ltd. for $2.53 billion, including debt.

stories.title: Grey Cup festivities didn’t push Calgary’s water use beyond restriction threshold
stories.summary: City of Calgary officials say a surge in CFL fans in Calgary for the Grey Cup didn't overburden the water system, despite ongoing water restrictions.

stories.title: Canada’s Alert Ready emergency system will test notifications on Wednesday
stories.summary: The emergency alerts are used by governments to inform the public of emergencies including tornadoes, floods, wildfires and Amber Alerts

stories.title: Russia calls for ‘consequences’ on Canada after World Juniors hockey ban
stories.summary: Russia is demanding the World Juniors be moved after the IIHF ruled its team out of the tournament and calls for consequences that would affect Canada hosting future sports events.

stories.title: Mack urges Fajardo to return after Grey Cup win
stories.summary: They had such a good time this season that Austin Mack can't see why Cody Fajardo would want to step away from the Edmonton Elks.
